structured_output.what_is_happening: This coin is a copy of an older token. It uses the same "https / had to take profits sir" ticker and name as an established pump.fun meme, 7sGd...pump (launched Dec 2025, about $81k market cap, $49k liquidity). It links to the original project's X community, not one of its own. The description, "Fees to @pumpameta via UsePaid", means the fees go to a third party. The deployer wallet has launched 166 tokens, and at least 3 other copies with the same name were launched within about 5 minutes of this one. It pumped +183-222% in its first 13 minutes to about $13k market cap, then dropped 30-36% in the last 5 minutes.

narrative.description: HTTPS ('had to take profits sir') is an existing crypto-Twitter joke meme coin. It already has a canonical token and CoinGecko/CEX-style price pages. This coin adds no new story of its own.
narrative.why_spreading: Most likely a wave of copies riding renewed activity on the original HTTPS token, with fees routed through UsePaid. I found no new event specific to this contract.

token_connection.why_this_token: None beyond copying the name. The social link points to the original HTTPS community.
token_connection.competing_tokens: Canonical: 7sGdNQSvUGpahh6qyXB3g5gsdK9FAzZM299KyCXspump ($81k market cap, $49k liquidity). Copies launched within minutes of this one: 3zhhHG... ($204k h1 volume), 3ymQkma..., 6Cm4..., FjdN..., and others.

authenticity.evidence: GMGN counts 185 bundler wallets and a bot/degen share of 0.34. The deployer has made 166 tokens and has already closed its position (creator_close). Fees go to a third party via UsePaid. It links to a community it did not create. Several same-name copies were launched at the same time.
authenticity.uncertainty: I had no access to X posts. Some of the roughly 580 unique buyers may be real degen traders.

structural_risks: Ticker hijack of an established token
Already down 30-36% from its peak in the last 5 minutes
Competing same-name copies split the buying

structured_output.counterargument: It is still tiny ($11.5k market cap) and trading hard, with about 580 unique buyers and $100k volume in 15 minutes. A copy like this can briefly 2x on flow alone if the original HTTPS token pumps again or a KOL picks this one.
